lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Approximately five to six horizontal rows of high-luminance, roughly circular pixel clusters are visible posterior to the branchial region, extending toward the caudal peduncle with higher density observed in the mid-lateral zone.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect the horizontal rows of high-luminance blobs, forming a localized grid of high-intensity nodes primarily visible in the mid-flank region between the pectoral and first dorsal fins.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A prominent linear feature is visible running horizontally across the upper third of the flank, defined by a sharp vertical intensity gradient with high-luminance values on the dorsal aspect and lower-luminance values (shadowing) on the ventral aspect.

other_distinctive_markers: Multiple slender, low-luminance silhouettes consistent with associated teleost fauna are visible in the ventral water column and trailing the posterior pelvic region.
